checks.finding: design.md, Design Decisions, gives concrete bases for the suite placement, extension-only registry change, structural seam, fingerprint policy, and resolved OQ-001 through OQ-003 choices, including links to the investigation evidence and existing lifecycle constraints.

design.md, Open Questions, lists only OQ-001 through OQ-003 and says none carries forward, while its Data Plan, Test Strategy, and Constraint Compliance sections explicitly defer the known-unsatisfied AC-026 contract to OQ-004; requirements.md, Open Questions, confirms OQ-004 remains open. The governing design therefore omits the active question's role owner, Blocks Implementation value, and concrete Resolution Path field. Failure mode: implementers and gates cannot determine who must authorize or execute the correction, whether implementation is blocked, or what evidence closes the knowingly unmet contract. Add OQ-004 to the design's Open Questions with those fields and reconcile the contradictory 'none carries forward' statement.

The assumptions in design.md are tied to requirements.md and investigation.md evidence, and shared-state assumptions are guarded by implementation-time fingerprint re-verification and hard-fail behavior on drift.

The design does not silently contradict a requirement: its Constraint Compliance table maps the requirements and explicitly identifies AC-026 as known-unsatisfied and deferred with rationale under OQ-004, so the documented deferral is evaluated under the open-question and verification checks instead.

No performance, throughput, latency, concurrency, or numeric SLO requirement is present in requirements.md; infra-spec.md also explicitly records that no runtime service or concurrency/SLO work is introduced.

design.md, Deployment Plan, and infra-spec.md identify local and three-OS GitHub Actions targets, later registration in run-all-tests.sh and test.yml, staged activation through the existing SKIP allowlist, rollback by reverting the additive scripts/registrations, and the absence of secrets, schema migration, or a feature flag.

design.md, Data Plan, states that no persistent data entities or existing-data migration are introduced; the contract additions are optional or net-new evidence schemas, so no migration/backfill plan is required.

design.md identifies no new external integration and fully names the internal integration surfaces: lifecycle libraries, workflow state and evidence files, compatibility fixtures, suite registration, and CI execution. The layer specifications are consistent with that boundary.

The proposed work stays within REQ-001 through REQ-007: it adds the compatibility suite and fixtures, narrows the registry extension, preserves the existing lifecycle architecture, and explicitly avoids a ninth orchestration loop or unrelated UI/runtime work.

design.md, Test Strategy, now explicitly says AC-026 has no passing verification path in this package and that no test claims it; Constraint Compliance merely defers it to OQ-004. OQ-004 in requirements.md describes a future amendment of the AC-009 hash but supplies no command, CI job, metric, acceptance artifact, end-to-end artifact, rollout monitor, or named review artifact that will demonstrate corrected exactly-once firing semantics. Failure mode: the pinned implementation can continue emitting a false done-transition before comparison and omit early-return transitions without downstream evidence detecting the contract violation. Define a concrete post-amendment test/evidence path and its pass condition. This finding evaluates the substantively amended round-2 Test Strategy and Constraint Compliance content documented in investigation.md's Round-10 extension, so the TYPE-H convergence exception for byte-identical previously passed content does not apply.
